segments.an3.141:1.1: “Tayo ca, bhikkhave, assaparasse [assasadasse (sī syā. kaṃ. pī.)] desessāmi tayo ca purisaparasse [purisasadasse (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
segments.an3.141:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.an3.141:1.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.an3.141:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assaparasso javasampanno hoti; na vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
segments.an3.141:2.3: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco assaparasso javasampanno hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca; na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
segments.an3.141:2.4: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco assaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
segments.an3.141:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco purisaparasso javasampanno hoti; na vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
segments.an3.141:3.3: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca; na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
segments.an3.141:3.4: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
segments.an3.141:4.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno hoti; na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
segments.an3.141:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
segments.an3.141:4.4: Abhidhamme kho pana abhiviniye pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti, no vissajjeti.
segments.an3.141:4.7: Idamassa na ārohapariṇāhasmiṃ vadāmi. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno hoti;
segments.an3.141:5.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
segments.an3.141:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
segments.an3.141:5.4: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṃsādeti.
segments.an3.141:5.8: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti; vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
segments.an3.141:6.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca?
segments.an3.141:6.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
segments.an3.141:6.4: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṃsādeti.
segments.an3.141:6.8: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.

lines: Tattha ayaṃ tīhi maggehi ñāṇajavasampannoti veditabbo.
